land.text: the island of Saint Lucia: 'Eventually, the British took complete control in 1814, shortly after the victory over French Emperor Napoleon I'

predecessors.note: 'France and Great Britain continued to contest Saint Lucia until the British secured it in 1814, as part of the Treaty of Paris'; 'Saint Lucia was considered one of the British Windward Islands colonies' (Saint Lucia page). The dossier starts at the Associated State date, 1 March 1967, as the sibling dossiers of Grenada, Saint Vincent and Antigua and Barbuda do; Cliopatria's own row begins in 1979. The colony itself has no dossier yet.

capitals.name: Castries
capitals.note: 'The nation's capital and largest city is Castries.' The page does not date the seat or give coordinates; the coordinates are the gazetteer's Natural Earth point.

correction.text: the island of Saint Lucia, an Associated State of the United Kingdom from 1 March 1967: 'Saint Lucia has a total area of 617 km2'

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe: Cliopatria's Saint Lucia row begins in 1979, twelve years after the Associated State of 1 March 1967 and at independence (22 February 1979). The country outline is used; the grid resolves it to 4 cells (about 1,012 km2) because the 253 km2 cell is larger than the 617 km2 island.

correction.text: the island of Saint Lucia: 'Saint Lucia has a total area of 617 km2'

keyframe_review.note: Cliopatria's 7-vertex polygon is 790.6 km2 against the infobox 617 km2 (ratio 1.28, within a factor of two) and its bbox (-61.04..-60.80, 13.66..14.04) is the island's. On the 253 km2 grid it resolves to 2 cells (about 506 km2) and leaves out the island's northern end, where Castries lies; Natural Earth's outline holds 4 cells (about 1,012 km2). The correction names the country so that the capital is inside the state. Same island through 2023; no border moves.

correction.text: the island of Saint Lucia: 'Saint Lucia has a total area of 617 km2'

keyframe_review.note: Identical to the 1979 shape (790.6 km2); same correction. The page lists no territorial dispute or border change since independence.

region.text: the island of Saint Lucia, one of the six members of the West Indies Associated States, with internal self-government

ledger.note: 1 March 1967: Saint Lucia becomes an Associated State of the United Kingdom. 'In 1967, Saint Lucia became one of the six members of the West Indies Associated States, with internal self-government'; infobox 'Associated State: 1 March 1967'. The West Indies Associated States page gives the same date and says the UK kept external affairs and defence; that client relation (1967-1979) belongs in the British Colonial Empire dossier as a vassal_start/vassal_end naming this state.

22 February 1979: Saint Lucia becomes independent. 'On 22 February 1979, Saint Lucia became an independent state, while remaining as a Commonwealth realm.' Same island and colour; the West Indies Associated States page gives the same date as the end of the association. Cliopatria's row begins in this year.

certainty.note: An island: the coast is the border and there is no land boundary. The Saint Lucia page records no territorial or maritime dispute and no border change since independence.

sources.title: Saint Lucia
sources.note: Identity, capital Castries, 617 km2, 1967 Associated State, 22 February 1979 independence, 1814 British possession; no dispute or border change since.

sources.note: Second page (budget 2). Table row 'Saint Lucia | 1 March 1967 | 22 February 1979'; the UK kept external affairs and defence. Also opened for commonwealth-of-dominica.

notes: Page budget 2 of 2 (Saint Lucia, West Indies Associated States). Start year: Cliopatria's row begins in 1979 (independence, 22 February 1979), but the island became an Associated State on 1 March 1967; the dossier starts in March 1967 as the am-08-k siblings grenada, saint-vincent and antigua-and-barbuda do, with a 1967-1978 keyframe. Independence is a rename (status change), not a new state. Cliopatria's polygon covers 2 grid cells, Natural Earth's outline 4: the polygon leaves out the north of the island including Castries, hence adjust verdicts naming the country (at this grid the island cannot be drawn smaller than 4 cells). Cliopatria's British Colonial Empire row still touches Saint Lucia until 1995 (seed neighbours 1979-1995), so eu-11 should release the island: vassal_start naming saint-lucia on 1 March 1967 and vassal_end on 22 February 1979. The pre-1967 colony (French crown colony 1674 as a dependency of Martinique; one of the British Windward Islands; British from 1814) has no dossier: suggested slug colony-of-saint-lucia, for am-08-x or eu-11. The page says the island 'changed ownership, or was declared neutral territory, a dozen times' in the 18th century; none of that falls in the dossier's years. No ruler list: the head of state is the British monarch (a Commonwealth realm) and a documented list was not opened.
